title: Blue Ridge Parkway
direction: Runs south from Rockfish Gap near Waynesboro, Virginia, along the Blue Ridge to Cherokee, North Carolina, at the edge of the Great Smoky Mountains.

stretches.title: Mill country
stretches.line: Rolling Blue Ridge farmland, with Mabry Mill near the start.

stretches.title: Around Grandfather Mountain
stretches.line: Includes the Linn Cove Viaduct on the slope of Grandfather Mountain.

stretches.title: The Craggies
stretches.line: High, open summits north of Asheville.

stretches.title: Into the Smokies
stretches.line: The highest miles of the parkway, ending at the Smokies.
